_comment: Hand-authored evaluation set. Each topic has one seed question (builds the object), paraphrases that express the SAME information need in different words (must HIT), and near-misses that are lexically adjacent but express a DIFFERENT information need (must MISS). Near-misses are the hard part and the point of the exercise: they share vocabulary and topic with the seed, so an embedding model that only captures topic will conflate them.

topics.seed: How long do refunds take to process?
paraphrases: What's the turnaround time on a refund?
When will I get my money back after requesting a refund?
How many days until a refund lands in my account?
near_misses: How long do refund disputes take to resolve?
What is the refund eligibility window?
How long does it take to process a new order?
